text.tspan: Sheet 2 Gate driver channel (1 of 6) and isolated bias supply
Shown for the high-side switch of phase A; the other five channels are identical. Symbol pin order is functional, not package order.
GATE_EN: 10 kΩ pull-down (sheet 4); low disables all six drivers.
nFAULT: 4.7 kΩ pull-up to 3V3 → FlexPWM_0 FAULT0 and a GPIO.
APWM/AIN (isolated analog channel) unused; option: module NTC.
Rectified ≈ 20 V; zener holds COM 5.1 V above VEE → +15 V / −5 V gate drive.
